classified_failure.frozen_guard: The v0.1 adapter required publisher_id, instrument_id, and venue sequence to remain identical from the first pending record through F_LAST.
classified_failure.direct_observation: The INTJ stream changed that three-field key before an F_LAST record, so the stage-separated classifier rejected the stream before normalization or feature replay.

corrective_interpretation.official_f_last_semantics: F_LAST marks the last normalized record in an event for a given instrument_id.
corrective_interpretation.official_xnas_sequence_semantics: Normalized records from the same Nasdaq TotalView message share the venue sequence number.
corrective_interpretation.what_is_proven: The frozen global publisher/instrument/sequence grouping invariant is incompatible with the observed INTJ record order.
corrective_interpretation.what_is_not_proven: The sanitized artifact does not reveal raw records and therefore does not prove whether the key transition was a synthetic session-boundary transition, instrument interleaving, or another valid normalization boundary.
corrective_interpretation.single_corrective_hypothesis: Buffer pending records independently by publisher and instrument until that scope reaches F_LAST, retain sequence on every canonical event, and restrict Fill-to-Cancel matching to the same venue sequence.
